rules.statement: When a mortgagee becomes the owner of the property mortgaged, the mortgage security is extinguished.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Vinculum Pignoris may be dissolved (or the Jus Pignoris extinguished) in many ways; for example, by the creditor becoming owner of the mortgaged thing by contract, succession, or otherwise; for just as one cannot have a servitude over his own property..."
